$comment: English texts of data/regions.json (src/engine/overlay.js): each region's card (name, description, land, trait), as the Combat tab shows them all, and its places. The name of a land is the same in all of its regions, as the casino groups the places of a land by it (src/engine/casino.js).

windfalls.name: Windfalls
windfalls.description: A belt of fallen trees on the edge of the wilds. Wolves, boars, deer and ravens, and deep in the thicket a wandering light and a storm-bringing Cloudherder.

trait.name: Sacred Grove
trait.description: Rest between fights restores 5% more HP.

windfalls-edge.name: Edge of the Windfalls
windfalls-edge.description: A sparse copse by the first fallen trunks. Lone wolves and badgers, grass snakes in the long grass, and squirrels hurling pine cones from the branches.

fox-ravines.name: Fox Ravines
fox-ravines.description: Sandy ravines full of burrows. Foxes hunt here in pairs, martens leap through the trees, raccoon dogs take over the fox dens, and antlions wait at the bottom of sandy pits.

raven-hollows.name: Raven Hollows
raven-hollows.description: Upturned trees with their roots to the sky. Ravens nest on them, a tawny owl hunts at dusk, weasels dart between the roots, and a capercaillie displays in the clearing.

viper-heaps.name: Viper Deadfall
viper-heaps.description: Sun-warmed heaps of trunks. A viper basks on every stone, hornets buzz and stag beetles scrabble in the rotten logs, and a snake eagle circles above the deadfall.

boar-thicket.name: Boar Thicket
boar-thicket.description: The densest part of the Windfalls. Churned earth gives the boars away, deer slip between the trunks, a wildcat lurks in the undergrowth, and a black stork wades in the stream. Tusk marks show on the trunks higher than a man can reach.

stone-glade.name: Stone Glade
stone-glade.description: A clearing with a ring of mossy boulders, beyond which the true wilds begin. Stonelings, spiders, lynxes and packs of she-wolves led by an alpha wolf.

trait.name: Stone Circle
trait.description: The character at the front has 5% more armour.

mossy-boulders.name: Mossy Boulders
mossy-boulders.description: The outer ring of moss-covered stones. Some boulders wake to life, the moss sometimes rises by itself, bats sleep in the cracks, and an imp leaps from stone to stone.

spider-gully.name: Spider Gully
spider-gully.description: A narrow gully shrouded in cobwebs. Spiders wait in their webs, a cross spider strings its nets above the gully, tarantulas hunt among the boulders, a fresh brood pours out from under the stones, and in the deepest burrow lives the birdeater.

lynx-ridge.name: Lynx Ridge
lynx-ridge.description: A rocky ridge above the clearing. Lynxes lurk on the ledges and drop onto their prey from above, mouflons walk the steep paths, an eagle owl circles over them, and a falcon plunges from the sky.

wolf-circles.name: Wolf Circles
wolf-circles.description: Clearings where the packs howl. She-wolves hunt together, led by an alpha wolf. A werewolf runs with the wolves, and a wolf shepherd herds them.

glade-heart.name: Heart of the Glade
glade-heart.description: The middle of the stone circle. Everything here is bigger and more dangerous: a bear lives in the thicket, the last aurochs grazes, an Aesculapian snake winds through the grass, and at night a Shriekwing flies. Among the boulders stand stone animals that no one ever carved.

backwaters.name: Overgrown Backwaters
backwaters.description: A valley where an old river lost its bed and spilled across the forest. Herons, beavers, catfish and crocodiles, and in the mist, drowned maidens and the water spirit.

trait.name: Reed Beds
trait.description: The character at the back of the line has 5% more dodge, hiding among the reeds.

reed-beds.name: Reed Marsh
reed-beds.description: A belt of reeds by the first water. Herons wade in the shallows, otters have trodden paths through the reeds, and giant mosquitoes whine above the water. Some clumps of reeds walk on their own.

beaver-dams.name: Beaver Dams
beaver-dams.description: Beavers have dammed the streams and flooded the forest. They defend their lodges, swarms of mosquitoes hang over the water, eels hide in the mud, and an eagle keeps watch from the dead trees.

drowned-forest.name: Drowned Forest
drowned-forest.description: Dead trees stand knee-deep in water. Cormorants perch on the dry branches, a catfish lurks in the shadow of the trunks, and what looks like a log is sometimes a crocodile.

willow-isles.name: Willow Isles
willow-isles.description: Islands of old willows in the mist. Wraiths and mistlings drift between the trunks, phantasms emerge from the vapours, willow spirits rustle in the treetops, and at night a Drowned Maiden dances on the water.

old-riverbed.name: Old Riverbed
old-riverbed.description: The old bed of the river, deep and dark. Bones lie in the mud, Drowners and sludgers climb out of the water, and mud goblins collect anything that glitters. Here lives the Nix, who keeps the souls of the drowned in jars.

peat-bogs.name: Peat Bogs
peat-bogs.description: Here the water has grown over with moss, and mists hang above the peat. Cranes, elk, leeches and sundews, and between the tussocks, will-o’-the-wisps, the kikimora and the bogman.

trait.name: Peat Fumes
trait.description: Poison lasts one turn longer, for creatures and characters alike.

crane-meadows.name: Crane Meadows
crane-meadows.description: Open moss bogs where cranes dance and black grouse battle over their courting grounds. Water lies under the moss, so every step sinks, and elk wade here chest-deep.

leech-pools.name: Leech Pools
leech-pools.description: Windows of black water in the peat, full of leeches and crayfish. Diving beetles hunt in the depths, and a marsh harrier circles above the water.

sundew-field.name: Sundew Field
sundew-field.description: Moss red with sundews that catch insects. Peatlings stride between the tussocks, a great owl hunts without a sound at night, and the fumes make your head spin.

smoldering-peat.name: Smouldering Peat
smoldering-peat.description: The peat smoulders underground, and acrid smoke pours from the holes, with a reek hiding in it. At night will-o'-the-wisps wander between the tussocks, salamanders warm themselves in the hot ash, and a Wyrm nests in the embers.

old-diggings.name: Old Diggings
old-diggings.description: An abandoned peat pit with log walkways. Peat cutters the bog never gave back still dig here, the Hoardkeeper wanders with his lantern, worms bore through the walls, rats scurry along the passages, and at the bottom of the pit the peat itself comes alive.

black-bog.name: Black Bog
black-bog.description: The deepest part of the Peatlands, where the water is black as tar. Alders stand here on stilts of roots, the pillars of an old temple rise from the depths, and in a thicket of creeping willow lives the Marsh Devil.

trait.name: Healing Mud
trait.description: Healing from skills and potions restores 5% more HP.

black-alder-carr.name: Black Alder Carr
black-alder-carr.description: A forest of black alders on stilts of roots, knee-deep in black water. Pond turtles bask on the roots, a mink darts between the trunks, and giant dragonflies hunt above the water.

black-tarn.name: Black Tarn
black-tarn.description: A round lake of bottomless black water, ringed by a mat of moss. A pike waits in the depths, a water spider lives in silver bubbles of air, and terns cry above the water.

sunken-shrine.name: Sunken Temple
sunken-shrine.description: A pagan temple the bog took long ago. Carved pillars rise from the water, and some of them still move. The serpent of Veles circles in the depths, and the ghost of a pagan priest still performs the rites here.

quaking-bog.name: Quaking Bog
quaking-bog.description: A thin mat of moss over bottomless pools of black water. The ground trembles at every step, the lantern eyes of a Mire Demon stare out of the dark, giant ticks lurk in the moss, and at dusk a night heron hunts.

rokita-deep.name: Marsh Devil's Abyss
rokita-deep.description: The blackest spot in the bog, in a thicket of old creeping willows. Green fire burns on the water, black goats and Fiends guard the way, and Pilferbirds carry plunder to their master. Here lives the Marsh Devil.

pine-dunes.name: Pine Dunes
pine-dunes.description: The first part of the Whispering Pines: dunes overgrown with heather and crooked pines. Further on the resinous forest murmurs, drifting sands bury and uncover old barrows, tar kilns smoke in the hollows, and beyond them lies a blackened burn, circled by the fiery Firehawk.

trait.name: Scorching Heat
trait.description: Burn lasts one turn longer, for creatures and characters alike.

heather-dunes.name: Heather Dunes
heather-dunes.description: Gentle dunes under a purple carpet of heather, with twisted pines on their crests. A sandman rises from the sand, a heather mare drifts over the heather, and at dusk nightjars skim low over the ground.

resin-pinewood.name: Resin Pinewood
resin-pinewood.description: An old pinewood where resin runs down the trunks like honey. A resin golem shuffles between the pines, barkborers gnaw at the bark, and at night tar moths flutter around the trunks.

drifting-sands.name: Drifting Sands
drifting-sands.description: A wasteland where the wind shifts the sand from place to place and uncovers old barrows. Drought husks wander the dunes, sand whirls spin, and barrow-wights come out of the barrows.

tar-pits.name: Tar Pits
tar-pits.description: The pits of the old tar burners, where wood still smoulders and birch tar bubbles. The ghosts of the tar burners guard their cauldrons, charcoal imps leap in the embers, and a Gale Sprite circles above the smoke.

burnt-forest.name: Burnt Forest
burnt-forest.description: A forest that burned in one terrible blaze. Charred pines and ash wraiths walk between the black trunks, and spark swarms keep the last flames alive. Here nests the Firehawk, the fiery falcon of legend.

silent-wilds.name: Silent Wilds
silent-wilds.description: A dense spruce wilderness where it is always night and no birds sing, and every hunter waits in hiding for whoever walks last.

trait.name: Thorns
trait.description: Bleeding lasts one turn longer, for creatures and characters alike.

spruce-dusk.name: Spruce Dusk
spruce-dusk.description: The fringe of the wilds, where dusk falls at noon under the dense spruces. Needlebacks leap from the branches, smooth snakes lie in the moss, and something rustles right behind your back.

fern-thicket.name: Fern Thicket
fern-thicket.description: Waist-high ferns where you cannot see your own feet. Millipedes crawl under the fronds, fernlings rise from the earth, and mantises wait above the ferns.

forgotten-track.name: Forgotten Road
forgotten-track.description: An overgrown road through the wilds, where abandoned wagons still stand. Dogheads lie in wait for travellers, a ghostly coachman's whip cracks at night, and gadflies as big as dogs circle above the road.

mossy-dell.name: Mossy Dell
mossy-dell.description: A deep ravine with an icy stream, overgrown with moss. The torn-up roots only pretend to be dead, living darkness gathers at the bottom, and stranglers' nooses hang from the edges.

wild-den.name: Wild Den
wild-den.description: The densest heart of the wilds, a lair full of bones and antlers. Bone gnawers crack the bones, carcasses rise among the carrion, and hounds bay in the dark. Here hunts the Night Huntsman.

new-moon-depths.name: New Moon Depths
new-moon-depths.description: The deepest night of the Whispering Pines. The Moon-Eater ate the moon here, old pines rustle without wind, and out of the dark comes what should lie beneath the earth.

trait.name: Ground Frost
trait.description: Chill lasts one turn longer, for creatures and characters alike.

creaking-pines.name: Creaking Pines
creaking-pines.description: Huge old pines creak and whisper, though no wind blows. Grey beards of lichen hang from the branches, something stirs in the hollows, and a murmur wraith drifts between the treetops.

rotting-logs.name: Rotting Logs
rotting-logs.description: Fallen trunks glow greenish with rot, and fungus grows inside them. Rotwoods lie like logs, puffballs smoke with spores, and earwigs crawl out of the cracks.

devils-crossroads.name: Devil's Crossroads
devils-crossroads.description: Four overgrown roads meet here in the heart of the forest. At midnight a headless one circles the crossroads, a Strawman invites you to dance, and a Sorrowling sings to those who have lost their way.

plague-graves.name: Plague Graves
plague-graves.description: A forgotten graveyard from the time of the plague, hidden deep in the forest. Dead men rise from their mounds, burying beetles dig under the earth, and at midnight the bell-ringer's bell tolls.

eclipsed-glade.name: Eclipsed Glade
eclipsed-glade.description: A glade over which the moon never rises. Abominations crawl along its edge, Tanglelocks roll through the grass, and a Bogeyman waits with a sack for whoever falls behind. Here lives the Moon-Eater.

scree-slopes.name: Scree Fields
scree-slopes.description: Grey rivers of rock on the slopes of the Bald Mountains, where nothing grows and the wind whistles between the boulders. People say these are the stones the devils were carrying to Bald Mountain and dropped when the rooster crowed.

trait.name: Rubble
trait.description: Mire delays the next move half as long again, for creatures and characters alike.

grey-scree.name: Grey Scree
grey-scree.description: A sea of grey boulders overgrown with lichen. Marmots whistle among the stones, and every shout comes back a hundredfold as an echo.

windy-ridge.name: Windy Ridge
windy-ridge.description: A narrow ridge where the wind sweeps you off your feet. Chamois leap across the rocks, and swifts dart screeching above them.

devils-stones.name: Devil's Stones
devils-stones.description: Huge boulders bearing the prints of devils' paws. In the middle stands a stone rooster that crowed before the devils could carry the stones to the summit.

vulture-crags.name: Vulture Crags
vulture-crags.description: Rock towers over an abyss, with vultures' nests on them. The ground below is white with bones, and the shrike's prey hangs on the thorns.

stone-throne.name: Stone Throne
stone-throne.description: At the top of the scree the boulders have settled into a throne. Around it sleep knights turned to stone, dormice and bee-eaters live in the cracks, and on the throne sits the Stone Giant.

fir-forest.name: Fir Forest
fir-forest.description: A dark fir forest on the slopes of the Bald Mountains. Witches walk its paths to the sabbath, and whoever strays from them never comes back.

trait.name: Fir Shade
trait.description: A character in the middle of the line has 5% more dodge, hidden in the shade of the firs.

fir-slope.name: Fir Slope
fir-slope.description: A steep slope of old firs, always in twilight. Wild tarpans graze among the trunks, and jays warn the forest with their screeching.

witches-path.name: Witches' Path
witches-path.description: A trodden path the witches take to the sabbath. Anthills as big as haystacks line it, and something giggles in the nightshade bushes.

misty-ravine.name: Misty Ravine
misty-ravine.description: A deep, damp ravine with a stream at the bottom, grey with mist even at noon. Slugs crawl over the stones, mistletoe hangs from the branches, and kingfishers dart over the water.

witch-glade.name: Witch's Glade
witch-glade.description: A glade in the heart of the forest where witches brew their herbs. The cauldron bubbles on the fire by itself, the broom sweeps by itself, and the witch keeps an eye on both.

cursed-manor.name: Cursed Manor
cursed-manor.description: An old manor deep in the forest where a light burns every night, though no one lives there. Its master is Twardowski.

bald-mountain.name: Bald Mountain
bald-mountain.description: The bare, windy summit of the Bald Mountains with an ancient stone rampart along its ridge. On the night of the sabbath witches flock here from all over the land, led by Baba Yaga.

trait.name: Sabbath Night
trait.description: Poison, burning, chill and bleeding last one turn longer, for creatures and characters alike.

stone-rampart.name: Stone Rampart
stone-rampart.description: An ancient rampart of stones around the summit, raised by people who worshipped the old gods here. On the night of the sabbath burning wheels roll down from it, a seeress tells fortunes on the wall, and nutcrackers hide nuts in the cracks.

witch-kitchen.name: Witch's Kitchen
witch-kitchen.description: Stone cauldrons on the slope where witches brew their potions for the sabbath. Herbs pound themselves in the mortars, and between the cauldrons hops a hare that is not a hare at all.

dance-circle.name: Dancing Circle
dance-circle.description: A trampled ring of grass where witches dance till dawn. A cursed piper plays here without end, magpies steal trinkets, and whoever steps into the circle must dance until they drop.

stone-altars.name: Stone Altars
stone-altars.description: Flat boulders where priests of old burned offerings. On the night of the sabbath the offering oven burns again, wax dolls lie on the stones, and the spinner of fate sits by the fire.

baba-yaga-hut.name: Baba Yaga's Hut
baba-yaga-hut.description: At the very top, behind a fence of bones, stands a hut on a hen's leg. Skulls burn on the fence, black geese walk the yard, and inside waits Baba Yaga.

navia-marshes.name: Misty Marshes of Nav
navia-marshes.description: Here the world of the living ends. Over the black water hangs a fog so thick that even souls get lost in it, and through the marshes flows the river beyond which Nav begins.

trait.name: Otherworld Fog
trait.description: Every blow has a 5% chance to miss in the fog, for creatures and characters alike.

misty-shore.name: Misty Shore
misty-shore.description: The grey shore of the river beyond which Nav begins. The fog hangs so low that you can see only your own boots and pale lights on the water.

viburnum-bridge.name: Viburnum Bridge
viburnum-bridge.description: A bridge of viburnum branches over the river of the dead. Red berries glow in the fog like drops of blood, and the planks creak with every step.

forefathers-isle.name: Isle of the Forefathers
forefathers-isle.description: An island in the fog where the forefathers rest. Their spirits sit by cold campfires and wait for their descendants.

crossing-of-the-dead.name: Crossing of the Dead
crossing-of-the-dead.description: An old landing from which canoes carry the dead to the other shore. On the pier wait the souls who have nothing to pay with.

gate-of-nav.name: Gate of Nav
gate-of-nav.description: A gate of black wood, as tall as the pines. Beyond it the fog ends and a meadow begins that no living soul has ever seen.

veles-meadows.name: Meadows of Veles
veles-meadows.description: Beyond the gate of Nav begin the meadows of Veles, lord of the underworld. The grass never withers here, though the sun never rises, and a green glow from under the ground lights the meadows. Here Veles grazes his herds and guards the treasures hidden under the roots of the World Tree.

trait.name: Veles' Sorcery
trait.description: Spells are 5% stronger, for creatures and characters alike.

eternal-pastures.name: Eternal Pastures
eternal-pastures.description: A meadow where the grass never withers. The herds of Veles graze here, animals so old that they vanished from the earth long ago.

golden-ravines.name: Golden Ravines
golden-ravines.description: Ravines where Veles hides his treasures. The gold lies in plain sight, but whoever reaches for it stays in Nav forever.

serpent-springs.name: Serpent Springs
serpent-springs.description: Springs from under the roots of the World Tree, where Veles in the shape of a serpent basks in the green glow. The water here is either living or dead, and no one knows which is which.

veles-oakwood.name: Oakwood of Veles
veles-oakwood.description: Old oaks under which offerings were made to Veles. Horns hang from the branches, and between the trunks you hear the rush of wings, though there are no birds here.

veles-court.name: Court of Veles
veles-court.description: A manor of black logs where Veles receives the dead at a feast. Heaps of gold lie by the gates, and inside burns a fire that gives no warmth.

sunless-land.name: Sunless Land
sunless-land.description: The deepest Nav, which the sun has never reached. Chernobog, the god of darkness, rules here, and Marzanna spreads eternal winter. In the frozen caves sleep creatures older than people, and somewhere in a castle of ice Koschei the Deathless has hidden his death.

trait.name: Sunless
trait.description: Healing restores 5% less HP, for creatures and characters alike.

frozen-caves.name: Frozen Caves
frozen-caves.description: Caves of ice where creatures older than people have slept for thousands of years. Their breath settles as frost on the walls.

road-of-the-dead.name: Road of the Dead
road-of-the-dead.description: A snowy road along which the dead have been carried for centuries. In the Sunless Land it is always winter, so sledges run here all year round.

black-lake.name: Black Lake
black-lake.description: A lake in which the sun has never been reflected. The water is black as tar and so cold that it burns.

chernobog-stronghold.name: Stronghold of Chernobog
chernobog-stronghold.description: A stronghold of black stone where Chernobog counts all the misfortunes of the world. The torches here burn with a black flame.

koschei-castle.name: Koschei's Castle
koschei-castle.description: A castle of ice and bone at the very bottom of Nav. Somewhere in it Koschei has hidden his death: in a needle, the needle in an egg, the egg in a duck, the duck in a hare, and the hare in a chest.

isle-of-buyan.name: Isle of Buyan
isle-of-buyan.description: An island in the middle of the sea, from which the World Tree grows: an oak so great that its roots reach Nav and its crown the sky. At its foot lies the white stone Alatyr, which stops blood in old spells.

trait.name: Alatyr
trait.description: Bleeding lasts one turn less, for creatures and characters alike.

rocky-cape.name: Rocky Cape
rocky-cape.description: A grey cape the sea has always beaten against. The waves break into spray here, and above the rocks the crown of the World Tree can be seen from afar.

shipwreck-bay.name: Castaways' Bay
shipwreck-bay.description: A shallow bay full of wrecks. The sea throws up here the ships that went looking for Buyan, and creatures of the deep live in their hulls.

sea-caves.name: Sea Caves
sea-caves.description: Caves the sea has washed out of the island's rocks. The water flows in all the way under the World Tree, and in the dark only jellyfish glow.

white-stone.name: White Stone
white-stone.description: The white stone Alatyr, the father of all stones. Whoever knows the old spell can stop any blood by whispering over it.

green-oak.name: Under the Green Oak
green-oak.description: The feet of the World Tree. Roots as thick as ramparts go straight down into the sea here, and among them lie acorns as big as barrels.

great-trunk.name: Great Trunk
great-trunk.description: The trunk of the World Tree is so thick that its bark forms cliffs, and resin flows down them and hardens into amber. Here you climb on bracket fungi as big as terraces, and hollows lead deep into the trunk like caves.

trait.name: Steepness
trait.description: Rest between fights restores 5% less HP and mana, as it is hard to catch your breath on the steep bark.

bark-cliffs.name: Bark Cliffs
bark-cliffs.description: Sheer walls of bark cut by cracks like ravines. The climb up them is long, and below only clouds can be seen.

fungus-terraces.name: Fungus Terraces
fungus-terraces.description: Bracket fungi as big as terraces grow out of the trunk one above another. You can rest on each of them, but nobody rests here alone.

honey-hives.name: Honey Hives
honey-hives.description: Old tree hives hollowed out in the trunk. Honey runs from them down the bark, and the bees guard it against anyone who comes near.

amber-cascades.name: Amber Cascades
amber-cascades.description: Resin runs down the bark here like a waterfall and hardens into amber. In the sun the cascades shine so brightly that it is hard to look at them.

bottomless-hollow.name: Bottomless Hollow
bottomless-hollow.description: A hollow whose bottom nobody has ever seen. It leads deep into the trunk like a cave, and from below you can hear the heart of the Tree beating.

sky-boughs.name: Sky Boughs
sky-boughs.description: The highest boughs of the World Tree, as wide as highways, reach the clouds. The wind blows so hard here that it is difficult to stand, and at night the moon drifts between the branches.

trait.name: Gale
trait.description: Everyone at the front of the line has 5% less armour, for creatures and characters alike, as the gale tears shields from their hands.

great-fork.name: The Fork
great-fork.description: Here the trunk parts into boughs as wide as highways. Every road leads higher, but you have to choose one.

cloud-bridges.name: Cloud Bridges
cloud-bridges.description: Narrow footbridges of cloud stretched between the boughs. The clouds hold a wanderer up as long as he does not look down.

sea-of-leaves.name: Sea of Leaves
sea-of-leaves.description: The leaves of the World Tree roll here like a sea as far as the horizon. Something you cannot see rustles beneath them.

moon-cradle.name: Cradle of the Moon
moon-cradle.description: Boughs bent like a cradle in which the moon rests at night. Silver light lies on the bark, and glowworms dance around it.

highest-bough.name: Highest Bough
highest-bough.description: The last branch of the World Tree, above the clouds. From here the whole world can be seen, and storms rumble overhead.
